title: Akundisco Script x  PC x MOBILE
features: Anti Hit Prevents or reduces damage to your character. Anti AFK keeps you active so you do not get kicked. ESP shows player or item locations through walls. Teleport moves your character instantly. NoClip lets you walk through objects. Speedhack changes your walk speed. Fly lets you hover or fly. Auto Farm gathers items automatically. Auto Quest completes missions. Auto Heal restores health. Desync hides your movements. Server Hop switches servers. Anti Detection hides actions from anticheat. Auto Equip equips items when needed. Logging shows alerts and info.
